content.title: Lionel Messi scores, but Inter Miami settles for draw in Nu Stadium debut
content.text: April 4, 2026Updated April 5, 2026, 12:05 a.m. ETMIAMI — Lionel Messi’s first goal in his new stadium was poetic.Ten minutes in. A header into the back of the net. A brief cloud of rain, opening and pouring, above the venue.He nearly delivered the game-winner, too – hitting the top of the crossbar before Luis Suarez was caught offside.However, Inter Miami’s inaugural match at Nu Stadium ended in a 2-2 draw on Saturday, April 4.Austin FC’s Guilherme Biro scored the stadium’s first goal, Jayden Nelson added a goal (53’) to push Inter Miami, which had scores by Messi (10’) and Suarez (81’).Nearly 30 years after the Miami Fusion aimed to play in the city, and 13 years since David Beckham vowed for his expansion franchise to do the same, Major League Soccer finally played a match in Miami.“I believe in Miami, and Miami believed in us,” Beckham said before the match. “Today, we stand in our new home. We are champions of the MLS. We have the best player in the history of the game playing in Miami. Dreams really do come true.”Inter Miami was unable to deliver a dream finish. Inter Miami vs. Austin FC highlights Inter Miami 2, Austin FC 2: Luis Suárez scores goalUruguayan great Luis Suárez makes his mark in the Nu Stadium opener, scoring the equalizer. Suárez connected with a left boot, following a header from Germán Berterame. Austin FC 2, Inter Miami 1: Jayden Nelson scores goalJayden Nelson scores past Inter Miami goalkeeper Dayne St. Clair in the 52nd minute. Inter Miami 1, Austin FC 1: Lionel Messi scores goalInter Miami quickly responds, and it’s a header scored by Messi. The World Cup champion converted on a pass from Ian Fray in the 10th minute. Austin 1, Inter Miami 0: Guilherme Biro scores goalFive minutes into the Nu Stadium opener, and Austin FC will celebrate the first goal in the venue after a header by Guilherme Biro after a set piece in the 4th minute. What time is the Inter Miami vs Austin FC match?The match begins at 7:30 p.m. ET (8:30 p.m. in Argentina). How to watch Inter Miami vs. Austin FC match?The match will be available to stream on Apple TV. Is Messi playing?Yes, Messi is expected to play.
